prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station PODS screen concept, a flat screen design that fills the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge (the outer 2 percent at left and right is bleed, trimmed later to 1024x600). Not a device photograph: no bezel, no buttons, no hands. Design at 1024x600 first: large shapes, few words, nothing smaller than 14 px type.
STYLE: exactly the approved Station look of the supplied Home screen: a hardware research instrument, deep blue-teal ground, graphite and slate chrome with fine bevels and hairline rules, small round status lamps, enamel, brushed metal and glass; one key light from the upper left, clean painted light with soft cast shadows, crisp edges, no noise, grain or dither; smooth sans-serif type (like Inter), cream on dark, small and quiet. The pod on its nest is the one warm, bright thing on the screen; everything else is cool and calm. No wood, no felt, no shelves, no lamp fixture drawn. Labels are one small engraved word, low contrast, read second: the object leads.
LAYOUT, as the supplied template: a thin graphite top bar (40 px) and bottom line (38 px). At the left a slim slate RACK COLUMN (160 px wide) with six round wells in a vertical row, three holding smooth seed-pods (green, blue, violet) and three empty, the top well lifted slightly with a thin cream focus ring, and at its foot a small return GATE: a slate hatch with an engraved leaf mark. At the centre of the stage the SPECIMEN: a sealed plum-sized seed-pod, warm green ribbed shell with a small embossed three-leaf mark, its top turned faintly translucent so the squat silhouette of a hopper shows inside, resting on a padded cream nest on a machined slate plate; a cool instrument beam from above-left pools warm on the pod, the brightest thing on screen. On the plate's front edge a small enamel name plate. Above the pod FOUR TRAIT VIEWPORTS in a shallow arc: machined slate rings with a fine bevel, an engraved emblem on each ring (a swirl, a crown, a drop, a paw), a small lamp, one quiet word under each. Their states, left to right: (1) MARKINGS, studied: the pane is clear and shows a close, warm, sculpted drawing of a plain charcoal flank, and on its sill rests a small misty pearl seed with a ghost of pale cream islands inside it; (2) CROWN: frosted pale blue-white glass with a single small four-point star glinting on it, nothing behind the frost; (3) COLOUR: frosted, nothing behind it; (4) GAIT: frosted, with two small joined rings engraved on its frame. To the right of the nest, on the plate, the FINGERPRINT WHORL: a round 96 px glyph of four petals of nested ink ridges, clockwise from top left, only the first petal lit in charcoal with a tiny cream dot at its base, a tiny leaf at the centre.
TEXT, exactly these and nothing else: top bar left "Pods  T5"; top bar centre a yellow lightning bolt "9", a blue diamond "4", a green drop "6"; top bar right "Companion away · with Dot". On a small plate under the nest "Hopper pod" large and "rock field · a hopper felt safe" small. One small engraved word under each viewport: "markings", "crown", "colour", "gait". Under the first viewport a small line "shows plain · hides pale". Bottom line: orange "✓ Study crown · 2" with a small blue diamond and grey "← Home" at left, grey "Hopper pod · identified" in the middle, grey "crown glints · something new" at right.
Constraints: no letters, ratios, percentages, DNA helices, codes or genes anywhere; frosted panes show frost only, never a blurred creature behind; no tables, title bars, bullet lists, progress bars or boxed buttons; no logos; no creature outside the window drawing and the faint silhouette in the shell; no people.
preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the approved Station Home screen: match its chrome, module materials, light and type exactly so the two screens read as one device; do not copy its layout. Image 2 is the approved pod in its cradle under a beam: the anchor for the pod and nest. Image 3 is the accepted rich Pip, the hopper whose traits the windows describe. Image 4 is layout truth only: the boxes and labels show where each element sits at 1024x600; it is not a style reference.

imageInputs.role: approved Station Home concept: the device's chrome, modules, light and type that Pods must match; not layout
approved pod in its cradle under a beam: the anchor for the specimen stage; its icons and type are not specs
accepted rich Pip, the hopper: the species whose traits the markings window draws (plain charcoal flank; pale islands as the hidden look)
layout truth only: flat boxes at 1024x600 (rack column, four viewports in an arc, pod on nest under the beam, name plate, whorl); not style
